name: gamefactory
description: GameFactory — Creating New Games with Generative Interactive Videos (arXiv 2025). Framework für action-controllable Game-Video-Generierung via Pre-trained T2V-Modelle + Action-Control-Modul. GF-Minecraft Dataset: 70h Gameplay, 2000+ Clips, Minecraft mit WASD+Maus-Actions. Utility-Scripts: Invalid-Jump/Collision-Detection, WASD+Maus-Visualisierung.
author: KlingAIResearch / KwaiVGI (Kuaishou Technology, University of Hong Kong)
covers: GF-Minecraft Dataset: 70h Gameplay, 2000+ Clips, WASD+Maus Actions
Invalid Jump Detection: Erkennt ineffektive Jump-Actions in Gameplay
Collision Detection: Detektiert Kollisionen mit Umgebungsobjekten
Action Visualization: WASD-Overlay + Maus-Cursor auf Video (visualize.py)
World Model Potential: Autonomes Fahren, Embodied AI
note: Trainings-/Inferenz-Code nicht open-source (Firmen-Policy). Enthält Dataset + Utility-Scripts.

entry_points.visualize: visualize.py — WASD + Maus Action Overlay auf Video
